title: src/successor drives the terminal host through a TerminalHost port with a herdr adapter, behaviour unchanged
body:
Why: Fable plan 1114e (.krn/runs/overnight/fable-plan-1114e.md) slice 1: Herdr leaks across src/successor (~25 run('herdr') calls, HERDR_PANE_ID x3, reply shapes parsed inline, probe.ts:163 regex).
Outcome: src/successor/terminal-host.ts port (self, open, type, agent, wait, busy, list, close, rename over opaque SessionRef); host-herdr.ts adapter; selection by env (HERDR_PANE_ID now, HC_TERMINAL_ID later).
Proof: contract suite over test/fixtures/herdr captures; grep "run('herdr'" src/successor hits only host-herdr.ts; npm run fast.
